name: zinput_directinput_report_error
description: zInput::DI_ReportError returns success for DI_OK, maps failing DirectInput HRESULTs to report text, and reports failures through zError::ReportOld.
known_limits: VC byte comparison from python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zinput_directinput_report_error passes under VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4: zero unmasked mismatches after masking 84 relocation bytes; BN size is 469 bytes, VC object symbol size is 480 bytes, and 11 trailing VC NOP bytes are trimmed.
The accepted branch shape keeps BN's final HRESULT tail: 0x800704df maps to DIERR_ALREADYINITIALIZED, DI_OK returns success, and other high-range fallthrough values report "Unknown Error".
